headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang resigns after Chinese spy affair scandal and lawsuits
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was summoned by Congress and investigated by his own board after reports that Chinese intelligence recruited an executive to have an affair with him. Huang admitted the affair, a second and third affair later emerged, and Huang left as CEO, with Nvidia naming CFO Colette Kress interim chief executive. Shareholders sued over the stock drop, and Trump floated Tim Cook as a possible successor.
